emailReminders.title: Email reminders
emailReminders.description: Besides the in-app reminders feed, get an email when something is coming due in the next few days (doctor follow-ups, IEP reviews, medication running out, documents, and more).

hero.title: Assess the Child's Sensory Profile
hero.description: A complete system for sensory assessment based on the Sensory Profile 2. Create assessments, generate reports, and share intake forms with the team.

assessments.title: Sensory Assessments
assessments.description: Apply the Sensory Profile 2 with 86-item questionnaires for children ages 3 to 14. Automatic quadrant classification.

anamneses.title: Digital Anamneses
anamneses.description: Record complete intake forms and share them via public links. Reuse data across multiple assessments.

reports.title: Automatic Reports
reports.description: Generate complete reports with normal-curve charts, classifications, and per-section observations.

cta.title: Start your first assessment today
cta.description: Sign up for free and start assessing children's sensory profiles with a professional, complete system.
